text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(We didn't win... Neither Bright nor I
placed
first...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That was a fine run, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What a shame to have lost! I was so sure
I would
be able to win after all that
preparation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: M-my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sob!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't supposed to lose here... This was
the one
race I couldn't afford to lose,
and yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm so pathetic! All I've done is make you
carry
the weight of our promise all by
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I cannot let things end here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I must accomplish what I set out to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We must surpass the victories that
previous
Mejiro racers like McQueen
and Ryan claimed
before us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And forge our own glorious legacies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose I must start training
anew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Bright seems like a different person.
She feels
strong and dignified, just like...
Yeah. She's just
like Air Groove.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're so incredible, Bright. What do I
have to do
in order to be like y—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober. As you are right now, the
future
and glory you crave are far
beyond your reach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because those are things that only one
person in
the world can ever claim.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And that person is Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? When...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When did I start wanting to become
someone
else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When did I decide that it was enough to
claim the
same achievements as someone
else?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober doesn't say a word on our
way back
from the Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's only after we arrive at my office that
she
begins to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I finally understand now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you were trying to say
after the
Osaka Hai, and what Air
Groove meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you were trying to say
after the
Osaka Hai, and what Air
Groove meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know why I can't become like Air
Groove,
Bright, or another Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't become someone else. I have to be me... right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to continue the legacy Ramonu
left
behind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The reason I decided to race in the
Triple Tiara
was because I wanted to be
like Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I walk the path she walked and reach
the
heights she reached... Maybe if I
become like
her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the reason I picked this race
schedule for my
senior year was because
I wanted to be like Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even today, I was thinking about how
great it
would be to be like Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I'm not like them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, Ryan, Bright, Air Groove, and

everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: They run with their own strength on their own path in their own way! They're determined to make themselves shine! That's what makes them strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I don't have that confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the resolve to make myself
shine! So I
just followed them, hoping to
pick up scraps of
their light along the
way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But doing that won't work. I can't forge a
new
Mejiro legacy that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not while I'm so weak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the fact that you always
reassure me.
Really, I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the fact that you always
reassure me.
Really, I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I want to confront my problems head-on. I need to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't keep ignoring the bad stuff. I have to admit that I'm a sneaky weakling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still... You believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still... You believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You believe that I can overcome my
weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You have faith that I'm strong enough to
do
that... right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I knew you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in the Takarazuka
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not doing it because I want to
chase after
Air Groove or because I want
to be like someone
else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in it so I can conquer my

weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in it so I can become truly
strong.
